hypothesis: September Indian Ocean Dipole and ENSO have established physical influence on East African short rains; predict future November-December rainfall, not economic output or market return.

region.name: Kenya-centered rectangular land region, not exact national boundaries

target: Cos(latitude) area-weighted mean GPCC gauge-only monitoring monthly land precipitation, November plus December in mm; current archive v2020 at NOAA PSL; 1982-2025. Missing months never zero-filled.
satellite: NOAA OISST v2.1 September-only mean ocean SST: IOD west10S-10N50-70E minus east10S-0N90-110E, plus Nino3.4 5S-5N170-120W. Exact coordinate-center bounds, cosine-latitude weights. Satellite-enhanced in-situ blend, not isolated satellite-only attribution.
forecast_issue: October20 12:00UTC; target starts November1. No current partial September 2026 forecast: data incomplete at research date.

availability.sst: September30+20days at00UTC (17dayfinalization +3daybuffer), strictly before issue12UTC; archive vintage unverified
availability.current_ground: NOAA CPC Unified daily gauge-only August and September regional totals; end-of-month+10day availability assumption. Used because GPCC monitoring has 2month latency and cannot supply September controls at October20. Current archive revisions disclosed.
availability.target_labels: Each December31+90days; never current target available before issue. Prior-season same release rule.

training: Expanding1982 to forecastyear-1, minimum17 fully observed trainingrows. First complete row expected1983 because GPCC prior-season1981 unavailable. Training-only standardization. All models share eligible support.
test: Every year1999-2025 inclusive; expected1999 abstention for fewer17 trainingrows, so26 forecasts2000-2025. Any additional source missingness explicitly abstains, no horizon extension or row selection.

models.baseline: Intercept plus yeartrend, prior Nov-Dec GPCC rainfall, current August CPC gauge rainfall, current September CPC gauge rainfall. Fixed ridge alpha5, training mean/std, unpenalized intercept. Clip prediction at0.
models.satellite: Same four baseline predictors plus September IOD west-east SST difference and September Nino3.4 SST; same fixed ridge alpha5.

uncertainty: Paired circular5year block bootstrap10000draws seed20260927, preserve calendar gaps, report all baselines.
gate: Satellite RMSE at least5%below strongest of four baseline RMSEs; lower MAE and positive95%RMSE-gain lower bound versus each baseline. No geographic, target, month, parameter or baseline search after observing outcomes.
source_quality: Gauge-only target independent of satellite SST. Ground network coverage/interpolation and archive revisions may affect values. GPCC and CPC share some gauges, acceptable for ground baseline. OISST blended in-situ; original vintages unverified.
claim_limits: Risk forecast of regional rainfall only, not crop/hydropower production or trading alpha
Known consensus relationship, no superiority to official forecast claimed
Region/mechanism selected after other failed satellite studies; no familywise correction
Current archived datasets, no historical release reconstruction
No tuning or alternative box/target after first result
